title: Bangkok on a budget: 4 days with Ayutthaya and the railway market
desc: A four-day budget route around Bangkok, from old-town temples to day trips to Ayutthaya and the Maeklong Railway Market, organised by area and day.

items.title: Thipsamai Pad Thai (ทิพย์สมัย)
items.memo: Well-known pad Thai shop in the old town.

items.title: The Grand Palace (พระบรมมหาราชวัง)
items.memo: Royal palace complex; the Emerald Buddha temple is inside.

items.title: Wat Pho (วัดโพธิ์)
items.memo: Temple next to the Grand Palace, home of the Reclining Buddha.

items.title: Wat Arun, Temple of Dawn (วัดอรุณ)
items.memo: Temple of Dawn on the west bank of the river.

items.title: Chinatown, Yaowarat Road (เยาวราช)
items.memo: Chinatown's main street; best in the evening for street food.

items.title: Khao San Road (ถนนข้าวสาร)
items.memo: Backpacker street with night-time stalls and bars.

items.title: Wat Chaiwatthanaram (วัดไชยวัฒนาราม)
items.memo: Riverside Ayutthaya temple with Khmer-style prangs.

items.title: Wat Mahathat, Ayutthaya (วัดมหาธาตุ)
items.memo: Ayutthaya temple ruins, known for the Buddha head in tree roots.

items.title: Wat Phra Si Sanphet (วัดพระศรีสรรเพชญ์)
items.memo: Three large chedis in Ayutthaya's former royal temple.

items.title: Cabbages & Condoms
items.memo: Quirky themed Thai restaurant in Sukhumvit.

items.title: Terminal 21 Asok
items.memo: Mall at Asok with each floor themed on a world city.

items.title: Maeklong Railway Market (ตลาดร่มหุบ)
items.memo: Market where trains pass right through the stalls.

items.title: Wat Sam Phran, Dragon Temple (วัดสามพราน)
items.memo: The Dragon Temple, a pink tower wrapped by a dragon; pairs with the railway market.

items.title: ICONSIAM
items.memo: Large riverside mall with an indoor floating-market food hall.

items.title: King Power Mahanakhon SkyWalk
items.memo: Glass-floor observation deck atop the Mahanakhon tower.
